Becca (CS): Heads up — weekend office hours for Acme and Kestrel are clashing with EMEA daytime. Can we reschedule handoffs? Prefer minimal CS overlap. Proposed: Acme Sat 10:00am PT / Kestrel Sun 6:00pm IST. Thoughts? @Priya @Samir
Priya (EMEA CS): Ack, Sat 10 PT is rough for EMEA. I can take the Kestrel slot Sun 6 IST if we swap Kestrel to the morning in NA?
Samir (CS): I can pick up Acme Sat morning if needed. What's the SLA ask for these sessions — are they support triage or onboarding walkthroughs?
Becca (CS): Acme is onboarding deep-dive (walkthrough + Q&A, ~90m). Kestrel is renewal check-in + product refresh (60m). We want continuity so customer doesn't get repeated info.
Alex (CSE): Suggestion: keep Acme as-is but move start to 11am PT so EMEA can join early evening. For Kestrel, move to Sat 7pm IST -> that's late for EMEA though. Might be easier to swap leads.
Maya (SE): For Acme deep-dive we need a short demo env prep window. Can we add a 15-min technical handover doc in the event description? I'll draft a checklist.
Jamal (CS Lead): Priority is to avoid two heavy sessions same weekend where one of us is on-call. Which of you is on rotation this weekend? @Samir @Priya
Samir (CS): I'm on-call Sat-Sun AM PT. So I should avoid the Acme deep-dive Sat morning.
Priya (EMEA CS): I'm off rotation but onsite interviews on Sun afternoon IST, so Sun 6pm IST may be tight.
Becca (CS): Ok new plan: Acme -> Sat 11:00am PT (Samir can't lead but can shadow at start), Kestrel -> Sun 3:30pm IST (earlier for EMEA). Can people confirm? I've created a quick Doodle: https://doodle.com/poll/abcd1234 (please pick)
calendar-bot: Event created: "Acme — Onboarding deep-dive" Sat 2025-03-22 11:00 PT, guests: Becca, Samir (shadow), Maya. RSVP pending from customer.
enablement-bot: Note: add 15m tech-handover doc to event description and attach runbook v2.0. Runbook link: https://redwood-internal/runbooks/acme-handover
Alex (CSE): Confirmed for Acme Sat 11 PT. I'll own the demo and Maya the checklist.
Samir (CS): Confirmed to shadow Acme and cover post-session follow-ups.
Priya (EMEA CS): I can take Kestrel at Sun 3:30pm IST. I'll prep renewal-risk notes.
Becca (CS): Awesome. Action items: 1) Maya — add 15m checklist to Acme event (done by Fri EOD). 2) Priya — update Kestrel agenda + risk tracker. 3) Alex — demo prep + quick smoke test environment. 4) Jamal — please double-check on-call rotation to ensure no clashes. I'll update the shared handover doc after events with customer feedback and any open action items. :thumbsup:
Maya (SE): Will upload checklist and a short "how to reproduce" snippet for the demo env. Example snippet: ```ssh -i key.pem ubuntu@demo-01.redwood.local```
Jamal (CS Lead): I'll review rotation and confirm by 18:00 PT today. If anything changes, ping this thread and I'll reassign.
Becca (CS): Also please capture NPS-style quick feedback in the post-session note: 3 Qs — usefulness, clarity, blockers. We'll add to the renewal risk playbook.
Priya (EMEA CS): Good call. I'll include the 3-question feedback in the calendar follow-up email template.
Becca (CS): Thanks all — I'll close the loop once runbook and event descriptions are updated. If anyone wants to swap last-minute, reply here.
Alex (CSE): Quick FYI — customer asked for recordings. Please enable recording in event settings.
calendar-bot: Recording enabled for "Acme — Onboarding deep-dive".
Becca (CS): Perfect. End-of-thread summary: Acme Sat 11 PT (Samir shadow, Alex demo, Maya checklist), Kestrel Sun 3:30 IST (Priya lead), handover doc updated, feedback template added. Will post post-session notes in #customer-success-reviews. :white_check_mark:
